channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Michael Carter-Williams | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Michael Carter-Williams from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Michael Carter-Williams
item.description:
Milwaukee Bucks HCJason Kidd:

“Rumors are a part of the Business. We're happy with Michael Carter-Williams!”

Jason Kidd on Michael Carter-Williams, Oct 7, 2016. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.

item.title: John Hammond on Michael Carter-Williams
item.description:
Bleacher Report SXM:Bucks GM John Hammond on Michael Carter-Williams:

“We're going to need him moving forward. He has the potential to be a Top-10 player at his position.”

John Hammond on Michael Carter-Williams, Jun 26, 2016. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Michael Carter-Williams
item.description:
Charles F. Gardner:Jason Kidd on Michael Carter-Williams:

“We talked about that today as a team. If sometimes you're struggling, the best way to correct that is by coming off the bench.”

Jason Kidd on Michael Carter-Williams, Dec 16, 2015. Source: Twitter @cf_gardner.

item.title: John Hammond on Greg Monroe, John Henson, Jabari Parker, Khris Middleton, Michael Carter-Williams, Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
John Hammond:

“We're trying to build around some kind of consistenty with the nucleus of Michael Carter-Williams, Khris Middleton, Jabari Parker, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Greg Monroe and John Henson. Those six guys are the young core that we look and say that's kinda the future of this organization,and that's not discounting anyone else. Other players have to step and become a part of that group with us. But those guys are the group we hope we can build some kind of continuity with.”

John Hammond on Greg Monroe, John Henson, Jabari Parker, Khris Middleton, Michael Carter-Williams, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Aug 21, 2015. Source: Brew Hoop.

item.title: Greivis Vasquez on Michael Carter-Williams
item.description:
Gery Woelfel:When I asked Vasquez if he could start for Bucks, he said,

“It's a possibility. Michael (Carter-Williams) is a really good point guard too. It's going to be a great level of competition. That's why they brought me here.”

Greivis Vasquez on Michael Carter-Williams, Jul 2, 2015. Source: Twitter @GeryWoelfel.

item.title: Brett Brown on Michael Carter-Williams
item.description:
Charles F. Gardner:Brett Brown on Michael Carter-Williams:

“You saw an emerging leader; you saw a tougher defender. You saw him not let referees get the better of him.”

Brett Brown on Michael Carter-Williams, Feb 25, 2015. Source: Twitter @cf_gardner.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Michael Carter-Williams
item.description:
Charles F. Gardner:Jason Kidd on Michael Carter-Williams starting:

“This is the start of the process of us moving forward. You're talking about a young kid who has done a lot early.”

Jason Kidd on Michael Carter-Williams, Feb 25, 2015. Source: Twitter @cf_gardner.

item.title: Brett Brown on Nerlens Noel, Michael Carter-Williams
item.description:
This week, a five-man Sixers contingent consisting of General Manager Sam Hinkie, head coach Brett Brown, Nerlens Noel, Joel Embiid, and Michael Carter-Williams traveled to Spain to watch the 20-year-old Saric firsthand.

“I am proud of the effort our three players – Nerlens, Joel, and Michael – have made to fly to Spain in order to show their support for Dario, another cornerstone of our program,”

Brett Brown on Nerlens Noel, Michael Carter-Williams, Sep 4, 2014. Source: NBA.com.
